A wet winding path through twisted pumpkin vines leads to a single imposing carved pumpkin on an old tree stump at center lower-middle. A few low pumpkin lights, distant dark village roofs and a pale moon through clouds. Burnt orange, antique gold, deep brown against midnight blue. Eerie, elegant, haunting, not cute; no scattered excessive lanterns.
